title: Maceify
description: This mod brings the Mace from version 1.21+ and its enchantments to version 1.20.4
body:
# Maceify

**This mod brings the Mace from version 1.21+ and its enchantments to version 1.20.4.**

Why wait to update your world, your server, or your favorite modpack? Maceify backports the best weapon in the entire game (the Mace) along with its full smash-attack mechanics and all three of its exclusive enchantments, fully playable on Fabric 1.20.4.

## ⚔️ The Mace

A slow but devastating weapon for players with good timing and no fear of heights:

- **6 attack damage** and **0.6 attack speed**: identical stats to the vanilla 1.21 mace
- **500 durability**, repairable with **blaze rods** in an anvil
- Found in the **Combat** tab of the creative inventory

## 💥 Smash Attack

The mace's signature move. Fall **more than 1.5 blocks** and hit an enemy before you land to unleash a smash attack:

- Bonus damage scales with fall distance: **+4 damage per block** for the first 3 blocks, **+2** for the next 5, and **+1** for every block beyond that
- A successful smash **completely negates your fall damage** — gravity is now a weapon
- Enemies near the impact are **knocked away** from the blast
- Impact particles and sound sell every hit

Drop from high enough and even the toughest mobs go down in a single blow.

## ✨ Enchantments

All three mace enchantments from 1.21 are included and can be obtained through the enchanting table, anvil, or commands:

**Density**:
Has 5 Levels. Extra smash damage for every block fallen. The higher the drop, the harder the hit.

**Breach**:
Has 4 Levels. Punches through armor, reducing its effectiveness by 15% per level.

**Wind Burst**: 
Has 3 levels. A successful smash launches you back into the air, with which you can chain smash after smash without touching the ground.

## 🛠️ Crafting

Since the Trial Chambers (and the Heavy Core) don't exist in 1.20.4, Maceify uses a simple custom recipe instead:

[White wool]
[String]
[Blaze Rod]

Place a **white wool block** on top, **string** in the middle, and a **blaze rod** at the bottom of a vertical column in a crafting table.

## 📋 Requirements & Notes

- **Minecraft 1.20.4** with the **Fabric Loader**
- Requires **Fabric API**
- Must be installed on **both client and server**
- Small differences from vanilla 1.21: the crafting recipe and repair item are custom (no Heavy Core or Breeze Rods in 1.20.4), and impact sounds/particles are close approximations built from what exists in this version
